caption: Two browsers on client 203.0.113.7 send to the same server address 192.0.2.10:80, so the destination port matches both. The server demultiplexes on the full four-tuple, and only the source ports 52000 and 52001 keep the two connections apart.

spec.title: Demultiplexing two segments at the server
spec.aria: Two browsers on host 203.0.113.7 with source ports 52000 and 52001 both send to server 192.0.2.10 port 80, and the server's four-tuple lookup separates them into two connections that differ only in the client source port.
